conclusions.subject: design
conclusions.text: Approved. The revision is confined to the three required fixes plus the Version bump: the checker's region digests confirm Work_schedule and Tile_pipeline are byte-identical to the version I verified line-by-line against the fixed source last round, Math_reshape changed only in the step-1 Symbol/Ledger and step-2 Math, and REALIZATION only in the Forbid split; my full re-read of the current 492-line raw found no other change. Fix 1: the step-2 gather sentence now matches the source exactly — kernel_m64.cuh:324-339 sets tail_fill = -1, replaced by the tile's own first stored id whenever the tile base is inside sparse_topk (which always holds for the last staged tile since 128*(tile_count-1) < active_topk <= topk_budget), and the gather clamps rows with max(id,0) at line 555, so 'a negative id still gathers physical row 0; a filler position instead gathers the row of its own tile's first stored id, or row 0 when that id is -1, and is invalid either way' is faithful, with no numeric consequence since filler positions are never valid. Fix 2: the residue Forbid is now two entries — the disabled value-load branch (kernel_m64.cuh:574-615, in the LOAD role and consuming PV operand source) on Items MAIN.LOAD/MAIN.PV, and the sink-seeded row sum (kernel_m64.cuh:746-755, inside softmax_wg_main of warps 0-3) on Items MAIN.SOFTMAX/Math_reshape::row_sum — so every listed Item corresponds to its shared Choice per DOC6, and the Reasons cite real design premises (the 131072-byte single KV region shared by both products; row_sum(-1) = 0 with no sink input in the Contract). Fix 3: active_topk and tile_count are now defined once, in the step-1 Math, with meaning-only Symbol entries — the prescribed form for integer counts under DOC3 (shape/dtype omitted, no value duplication) — and the Ledger Gain references tile_count without restating its definition; both remain legitimate registrations as cross-region interfaces since Tile_pipeline's Index definitions ([0, tile_count], ceil_div(tile_count,2), n[u, tile_count-1]) consume tile_count. All previously verified content stands: the masked-tile selection reproducing the Contract's compacted s(t), the unscaled mm32 scores with ssl inside exp2, the online recurrence with the -inf fallbacks, 2^8 prescale, satfinite E4M3 narrowing, unrounded per-half row_sum and declared ftz/approx path, the single normalization with the late bmm2_scale and head_count guard, the item mapping equal to the launched grid, the CLC refill/exit protocol, the seven roles with exact warp ranges and register budgets, the storage account reproducing 191104 bytes, and every Waiting edge matched to barrier participant counts (k_empty 2 = QK+PV, index_empty 256 = LOAD+SOFTMAX, source_work_empty 480 = six roles, tmem_dealloc 448 = fourteen warps, throttle 128/32) and reuse distances (score n+2, prob n-2, id ring g-6, reply u-2). The zero-tile item remains a source limitation in Forbid #1 without added waits; dead residues (tmem_ld_x4 at 805-806, unused exchange regions and pair barriers) stay unmodeled and destined for the P4 catalog residue sentence.

conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: Re-affirmed on the revised document; the revision touched no execution semantics (Work_schedule and Tile_pipeline digests unchanged), so my previous end-to-end trace of fixed case 5 remains valid against the current raw, and the corrected step-2 text does not change this case (topk_budget 512 = 128*4 leaves no filler positions). Trace summary: case 5 (16 requests x 3 rows = 48 tokens, head_count 128, qk_dim 512, page_size 64, topk_budget 512, random/scattered) — Model.forward accepts and forwards the caller's out to s4_tc_forward; token_count 48 > 32 defeats the split predicate and dim 512 defeats tail/cluster, so aka_s4_indexed_m64_d512 launches with smem 191104, clusterDim {1,1,1}, block 512, grid 48*ceil(128/64) = 96 = Worker_count, each CTA preassigned one item; item w maps to token w/2 and head group w%2, matching mapped_query_idx = w/head_groups and head_idx = my_row + (w%2)*64. Per row seq_lens = sparse_mla_top_k_lens = 512, so active_topk = 512, tile_count = 4, two id passes stage exactly 512 ids with no filler; LOAD fills q_slot (32768B, both head groups in range) and per tile issues 128 gather4 announcing 65536B into kv_ring slot n%2; QK issues 16 products per tile into tmem columns (n%2)*128 with the first product initializing, committing k_empty and s_full; SOFTMAX takes the full-tile fast path (valid_sparse_cols = 128, clean ballots), merges half maxima, publishes rescale(n), stores the E4M3 prob tile and accumulates the unrounded per-half row_sum; PV issues 8 products per tile into columns [256,512) through the transposed descriptor on the same kv slot, committing k_empty, p_empty and o_full so the KV slot needs both commits; CORRECTION releases o_slot for tile 0, conditionally rescales tiles 1-3, waits o_full of tile 3 and sum_ready, merges half sums, forms inv and writes 64x512 bf16 per item guarded by head_idx < 128 (all pass). The two items per token cover all 128 heads, so 96 items cover every element of the 48x1x128x512 output with no global intermediate and untouched scratch buffers; on the 148-SM acceptance machine all CTAs are resident, try_cancel returns no cancel, every role exits after one item on refill_exhausted, the five tmem users signal and warp8 deallocates the 512 columns. First-round (d=0 no rescale, accumulator initialized), steady-state, last-round (s_drain, final waits, teardown) and terminating-reply situations are each exercised.

conclusions.subject: dependencies
conclusions.text: Unchanged by the revision and re-affirmed: the bound entry candidate/solution.py::Model.forward binds self._call = s4_tc_forward, so the chain is Model.forward -> s4_tc_forward -> aka_s4_indexed_m64_d512 — one launch, no second kernel, no host-side scratch inside root's when (the split path's partial/stats and merge kernel are excluded by the when; workspace_buffer and multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer are never forwarded). Per call the host encodes the 4-D query map (box {128,64,1,1}) and the 2-D physical-row cache map (box {128,1}), both SWIZZLE_128B/OOB_FILL_NONE (which also zero-fills tail head rows), raises the max dynamic smem attribute to 191104 once per device, and launches via cudaLaunchKernelExC with the explicit single-CTA cluster dimension and spread policy. Verified mechanism dependencies: TMA gather4 for arbitrary physical rows and 4-D tiled query loads with the announced 65536/32768-byte publications; tcgen05.mma cta_group::1 kind::f8f6f4 with FP32 TMEM accumulators and the 0x4000000 transposed B-descriptor letting the value product reuse the kv_ring slot; tcgen05.commit as the single completion covering accumulator visibility and operand reads, which the shared k_empty release (init 2), q_empty, p_empty and o_full edges rely on; clusterlaunchcontrol.try_cancel/query_cancel for refill, requiring the cluster launch; the whole 512-column tcgen05.alloc from warp0 with relinquished permit and dealloc from warp8 gated on the 448-count barrier; ex2.approx.ftz/rcp.approx.ftz, cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2 and the packed ftz f32x2 operations behind the declared numeric path and Prefer. Register budgets (152/144/136x4/72) and the 512-thread launch are handed to Realization. The hardware area remains the P1 placeholder skipped by policy: the one-worker-per-SM statement rests on the full TMEM allocation, the 191104-byte image and __launch_bounds__(512,1), not on a registered device capacity.

conclusions.subject: document_self_contained
conclusions.text: Passes on the revised raw. root.yaml reads standalone: every symbol is registered or defined where used; after fix 3 each of active_topk, tile_count and ssl has exactly one definition source (step-1 Math for the two counts, Symbol.value for ssl), all other symbols are Math-defined with the interface values (raw_score, prob, prob_e4m3, row_max, rescale, row_sum, value_acc) carrying complete shape/dtype/retention; Contract objects are referenced by original names and every ref: target (query.dtype, kv_cache.dtype, block_tables.dtype, out.dtype) resolves inside the shared Contract; Tile_pipeline indices, storages, views, roles, action families and Waiting references all resolve locally with no reliance on the catalog, process records or any prior draft; the cross-region use of tile_count in the Index definitions is covered by its registration and Math definition. The n name serving both as the Contract/Math selection count n(t) and the Tile_pipeline flatten index remains acceptable under DOC5's separate-responsibilities rule with each locally defined.

conclusions.subject: document_layering
conclusions.text: Passes. The Contract still defines only the task (domain sizes, selection/score/softmax/accumulation math matching reference.py, in-place output, scratch side effects, the source-recorded Tolerance with its explicit no-defaults statement); Math_reshape decides values and precision only; Work_schedule fixes decomposition, mapping, order, refill and exit without thread-level detail; Tile_pipeline binds roles, members, registers, storages and events inside the work boundaries; REALIZATION lands only primitives, budgets and exclusions the upstream left abstract. The revision did not disturb layering — the two new Forbid entries cite upstream premises (the registered 131072-byte kv_ring and the declared row_sum(-1) = 0 initial state) rather than introducing new roles, buffers or waits, and the removed Symbol.value strings left the definition in the math layer where it belongs. The dispatch.md draft still defers to the YAML: its root row's 'when 待 P3 写实' is now fulfilled by the landed Dispatch.when, and no catalog text overrides any YAML decision.

conclusions.subject: document_consistency
conclusions.text: Passes with the previous inconsistency resolved. The corrected step-2 filler sentence is now consistent with step 1 ('carry a filler id and are never valid'), with the kv_block formula kv_row(max(sel_id,0)) read together with the filler definition, and with the step-1 Ledger Cost ('a -1 id still gathers physical row 0', true for negative ids of any origin); the split Forbid entries are mutually consistent and consistent with Require #2 (the transposed single-ring value operand) and Math step 3 (row_sum(-1) = 0), with no duplicated or conflicting exclusions. All previously verified consistency relations stand unchanged: Worker_count = grid = total_work_items; the storage byte account reproduces 191104; every Waiting edge matches a real barrier participant set and reuse distance; index-window shifts follow the DOC5 skip rules; the m(t)=0 numeric path is defined while the tile_count=0 execution gap stays a Forbid with the domain-unreachability fact; declared-but-consumerless events (final_max publication, discarded tail head rows) are retained with their costs in the Ledgers.

conclusions.subject: document_relevance
conclusions.text: Passes. The revised text stays within design-necessary content: the new filler sentence adds exactly the source fact needed to make the gather model well-defined for the topk_budget = 2052 corner without importing staging-code detail; the two Forbid entries document concrete repeatable risks (dead branches physically present in the fixed source) with cost-based Reasons and no process narrative; the meaning-only Symbol entries drop redundant duplication without losing any needed attribute. No process state, revision history or prior approvals appear in the YAML; the kept research trade-offs (the approximate-primitive unknown bound, the zero-tile source limitation, the dead-residue exclusions, the consumerless final_max) remain the sanctioned kind of recorded source restrictions, each tied to a design consequence.

response.handoff: P3 approved: root.yaml Version 4 is the complete, source-faithful root design for aka_s4_indexed_m64_d512 (all three prior revise issues fixed and re-verified; only Math_reshape, the Forbid split and the Version changed). Entry for P4: materialize the two planned nodes the checker still reports missing (split8_merge.yaml, cluster_m128.yaml) and finalize dispatch.md — the root row's '精确 when 待 P3 写实' note is now fulfilled by Dispatch.when (qk_dim = 512 outside the split selection), and the residue sentence should absorb the newly located dead code: the four-column tcgen05.ld into _tmem_load_0 never read (kernel_m64.cuh:805-806), the unused softmax/corr warp-pair exchange regions at 166912/167936 (1536 bytes, named in the smem Require), and the unused s_seeded/q_pair_ready/kv_pair_ready/pv_pair_ready/tmem_dealloc_peer barriers. Naming anchors P4/P5 must reuse: roles INDEX, LOAD, SOFTMAX, CORRECTION, QK, PV, SCHED; indices u/d/n/r/g; storages q_slot, kv_ring, index_ring, prob_ring, tmem_acc (views raw_score(n) columns (n%2)*128..+128 and value_acc columns [256,512)), rescale_slot, sum_slot, final_max_slot, reply_ring; math symbols active_topk, tile_count, sel_id, valid, raw_score, ssl, row_max, rescale, prob, prob_e4m3, row_sum, value_acc. For P5: root's numeric path must not be inherited by cluster_m128 (no -8 prescale, max-hysteresis bound, dequantized-mass row sum per the catalog row); split8_merge shares the kernel_m64.cuh body under S4_SPLIT=1 but replaces the epilogue with raw fp32 partial/stats writes plus the merge kernel, changing the output producer and needing its own Work_schedule steps and Handoff, and its empty-split filtering via s4_split_has_work means root's zero-tile Forbid wording must not be copied verbatim. Documented unknowns that no root claim depends on: the exact TMEM lane/column packing behind i_desc 69206032/71368720 and the 16x32bx2/32x32b load patterns, the D576 tail box(128B)-over-64-feature zero-fill semantics (tail record scope), and the smem P/epilogue swizzle bit forms. The zero-tile work-item barrier mismatch remains a located source limitation carried in Forbid #1 and the catalog paragraph; kernel-issue registration is the Supervisor's decision, and schema approval does not assert the source kernel is correct.

source_evidence.note: Bound implementation entry Model.forward: __init__ binds self._call to s4_tc_forward; the guard admits qk_dim in {512,576} with head_count <= 128 and passes the caller's out plus float scales straight through, returning the same buffer object.

s4_tc_forward: ABI checks, tokens==0 early return, the split predicate tokens<=32 && heads<=64 && topk>=1024, and kernel selection — qk_dim 512 makes tail and cluster false so aka_s4_indexed_m64_d512 launches with smem 191104; root.yaml's Dispatch.when matches this routing exactly.

cudaLaunchKernelExC with clusterDim {1,1,1} and the spread policy, gridDim tokens*((heads+63)/64), blockDim 512, dynamicSmemBytes — the source of Worker_count, the cluster-launch Require and CLC refill availability.

query_map 4-D dims {128,heads,4,tokens} box {128,64,1,1} and cache_map 2-D over physical rows {512, rows} box {128,1}, both SWIZZLE_128B with OOB_FILL_NONE — the 64x512 query block with zero-filled tail head rows and the row-wise gather encoding.
The selected explicit instantiation aka_s4_indexed_m64_d512 with S4_ROPE=0, S4_SPLIT=0, SMEM_TOTAL=191104 — the P2-selected root instance.
head_groups = ceil(heads/64); non-split total_work_items = tokens*head_groups — Worker_count equals the launched grid and the item count.

Non-split validity is only the linear bound w < total_work_items and mapped_query_idx = w/head_groups — the item-to-token mapping and the predicate that admits zero-tile items carried as the Forbid #1 limitation.
active_topk = min(max(0, seq or min(seq,lens)), sparse_topk) and tiles = ceil(active_topk/128) — the sole definition source now written in Math step 1 after the Symbol.value deduplication.
INDEX: num_index_passes = (tiles+1)/2, one index_empty-gated 1024-byte stage per pass holding 256 ids copied by 16-byte cp.async per lane — the r/g domains and the six-slot index_ring.

Fix-1 anchor: tail_fill = -1, replaced by row_tile_ptr[0] — the tile's own first stored id — whenever tile_col_base < sparse_topk; columns below budget keep real ids. The revised step-2 sentence ('a filler position instead gathers the row of its own tile's first stored id, or row 0 when that id is -1, and is invalid either way') now states this rule faithfully.
The pass is published by cp.async.mbarrier.arrive on index_full and the producer stage wraps at 6 — load:ids' done publishing to both readers and the g%6 slot view.
LOAD rounds bounded by total_work_items+1, each opening with the two-slot throttle wait/arrive pair — acquire:throttle and the reply-driven round structure.

All four loader warps wait q_empty, then one elected lane announces 32768 bytes and issues four 4-D TMA loads at head coordinate (w % head_groups)*64 — load:q, its release edge and the zero-filled tail head rows.

Per tile: index_full awaited on even tiles, k_empty gates the slot, 65536 bytes announced; 4 warps x 8 groups issue gather4 at column feature*128 with rows max(ids[i],0) — the gather clamp behind the corrected 'negative id gathers row 0 / filler gathers its tile's first id's row' statement.
The k stage wraps at 2 and the loader's index_empty arrive fires only at the pair end — release:id_slot keyed to the staging pass and the kv_ring n%2 view.
Fix-2 anchor: the '} else if (0)' disabled separate value-load branch inside the LOAD role — the residue now forbidden by the Forbid entry whose Items (MAIN.LOAD, MAIN.PV) match that Choice.
SOFTMAX on warps 0-3 with setmaxnreg 152: ssl = bmm1_scale*1.4426950408889634, my_row = warp%4*16 + lane%16, n_half = lane/16 — the Member/Register entries and the ssl Symbol value.

Fix-2 anchor: row_max_val = -inf and row_sum_val = 0 per item, with the sink-seeded row_sum (256.0f for n_half==0) disabled under has_sinks==0 inside this softmax_wg_main block of warps 0-3 — the residue now forbidden by the entry anchored on MAIN.SOFTMAX and Math_reshape::row_sum, whose Reason cites row_sum(-1) = 0 and the absent sink input.

The tile loop derives phase from the cross-work softmax_tile_cursor and valid_sparse_cols clamps this half's valid columns to the selection window — the flatten index n and the over-window mask predicate.

Per tile SOFTMAX waits s_full, reads the staged ids, ballots negative entries into per-half invalid masks and arrives index_empty at the pair end — compute:mask, the score Prepared edge and SOFTMAX's release:id_slot.

Half-max reduce, tcgen05.wait::ld then the s_empty arrive, the shfl_xor 16 merge into row_max, acc_scale = old > -inf ? exp2(fma(old,ssl,-new*ssl)) : 1.0 published via smem_stats_max and the stats arrive, and max_scaled = safe_max*ssl - 8.0 — the step-3 recurrence with its -inf fallbacks and the fixed 2^8 prescale.
prob = approx_exp2 of the packed ftz fma(sv, ssl, -max_scaled) over the half's 64 columns — the prob formula exp2(fma32(masked_score, ssl, -(ssl*top - 8))) and its declared ftz argument.
Weight narrowing by cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 — the prob_e4m3 step and its Require binding.

The E4M3 tile is stored into smem_p_fp8 + phase*8192, a half with no valid column stores zeros, and p_full is arrived after the store — prob_ring's n%2 view, the zero-half path and the publication to PV.

block_sum reduces the unrounded prescaled probs via four f32x2 partials merged once and row_sum = fma(row_sum, acc_scale, block_sum) per half — the row_sum recurrence, the Accumulate note and the Cost on the unrounded sum.
Once per item SOFTMAX waits source_sum_empty, writes sum and final_max per stats_row and arrives sum_ready — final_stats, the two single slots and the Released edge on CORRECTION's u-1 return.
SOFTMAX teardown: wait::ld then the tmem_dealloc arrive — signal:tmem_free with its drain clause.

CORRECTION's unconditional first stats wait plus o_empty arrive per item and the tile loop from 1 waiting stats, reading acc_scale and waiting o_full of the previous tile — release:o_slot for every d, rescale only for d>0, and the unpaired first wait behind the zero-tile Forbid.

The in-place accumulator rescale runs only when __any_sync(acc_scale < 1), multiplying the tmem columns 256+ in 16-column chunks before arriving o_empty — compute:rescale's conditional describe and the single value_acc ping-pong.

Epilogue waits: o_full of the last tile and sum_ready, the sum/final_max reads, the source_sum_empty arrive, the shfl half-sum merge and inv_sum = total > 0 ? approx_rcp : 0 — compute:norm's predecessors, release:sum_slot and the zero-row path.

16-column TMEM chunks scaled by inv_sum*output_scale via packed mul.rn.f32x2, narrowed with __floats2bfloat162_rn and stored directly into O under head_idx < num_heads — store:out and the single late bmm2_scale.
CORRECTION teardown: wait::ld then the tmem_dealloc arrive.

warp8 waits q_full per item and k_full per tile, then issues the score products with i_desc 69206032, the first with enable_input_d=0 — matmul:q@k, its operand-ready edges and the per-tile score-block initialization.
elect_commit on k_empty[stage] (wrap 2) then s_full[phase], and the tile>=1 burst also opens with enable_input_d=0 — the shared KV-slot release with PV and per-tile score initialization.

Per tile warp8 waits s_empty of tile+1 before the next burst, commits q_empty once per item, then drains s_empty at last+2 — the Released edge matmul(n+2) ← score(n), release:q_slot and await:s_drain.
warp8 arrives tmem_dealloc, waits it and runs tcgen05.dealloc of 512 columns — await:all_tmem_free and release:tmem.

SCHED warp10 per round: throttle_full wait / throttle_empty arrive, source_work_empty wait (returned by the six consuming roles), expect_tx 16 and clusterlaunchcontrol.try_cancel into work_response[stage*16] — release:throttle, compute:claim and the two-slot reply ring.
SCHED breaks on the first non-canceled reply and absorbs two further source_work_empty waits — refill_exhausted and await:drain.

PV per tile waits p_full[phase], o_empty and k_full[v_stage], issuing eight products with A from smem_p_fp8 + phase*8192 and B from the same kv ring via the 0x4000000 transposed descriptor bit, i_desc 71368720, enable_input_d=0 only on the item's first tile — matmul:p@v with its three Prepared predecessors.
